headline: ProvidusUnity Bank Enables Google Pay for Mastercard Holders in Nigeria
summary: Nigeria's ProvidusUnity Bank enabled eligible Mastercard holders to transact through Google Pay, expanding contactless mobile wallet adoption based on tokenization infrastructure built with Thales and Mastercard.
why: Digital wallet expansion across Sub-Saharan Africa accelerates the displacement of cash and improves payments infrastructure for retail commerce.

impacts.name: African Fintech & Payments
impacts.why: Integration with major mobile wallets expands consumer digital transaction volume.
